fit: cranberry drink and HADS depression and POMS depression-dejection in healthy students
assessment: HADS depression overall and week 12 were inconclusive. The distinct POMS depression-dejection score was higher at week 4 by 3.34 points (95% CI 0.526 to 6.16, p = .02). Later contrasts and the main treatment test were inconclusive. The article reports a treatment-by-visit p = .02 for the subscale. The frozen exposure and Parkinson population were not tested.
